verdict.rationale: E2B is API/SDK-first. The SDK covers the core sandbox lifecycle: create, run code, filesystem read/write/list, commands, pause/resume, setTimeout, kill, metrics, templates, network allow/deny lists and lifecycle webhooks. An official CLI adds listing, shutdown, snapshots and CI-friendly API-key auth, so core operations clearly don't require a UI. However, no source explicitly claims API–UI parity, and probes found no published OpenAPI spec. Missing for 10: evidence that dashboard-only functions (API key, team, billing and usage management) are API-accessible, a published OpenAPI/REST spec, and independent confirmation of parity.
